mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT subscription_id FROM user_push_subscriptions WHERE 1=0 UNION ALL SELECT subscription_id FROM push_deliveries WHERE 1=0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_push_subscriptions SET public_key=#{publicKey},auth_secret=#{authSecret},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE endpoint_hash=#{endpointHash} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_push_subscriptions WHERE endpoint_hash=#{endpointHash} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.subscription_id,p.user_id,p.endpoint,p.endpoint_hash,p.public_key,p.auth_secret FROM user_push_subscriptions p JOIN users u ON u.user_id=p.user_id WHERE u.push_enabled IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(CAST(u.push_enabled AS VARCHAR2(10)))) IN ('1','Y','TRUE') ORDER BY p.subscription_id
SELECT CASE WHEN push_enabled IS NULL OR UPPER(TRIM(CAST(push_enabled AS VARCHAR2(10)))) IN ('1','Y','TRUE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM users WHERE user_id=#{value}
